name: ESP32 Devkit
summary: Integrated ESP32 IoT board with LoRa, RTC, microSD and two relay channels, powered by 220VAC.
description: A single integrated board combining an ESP32 microcontroller (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth), a long-range LoRa module, a battery-backed Real-Time Clock (RTC), an I2C interface with selectable 3.3V or 5V levels, two relay channels for controlling AC/DC electrical devices, and a microSD card slot for data logging.
disclaimer: Personal project by Hoàng Duy. Specifications describe the design; manufacturing and qualification results are not published.

overview.text: A single integrated board combining an ESP32 microcontroller (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth), a long-range LoRa module, a battery-backed Real-Time Clock (RTC), an I2C interface with selectable 3.3V or 5V levels, two relay channels for controlling AC/DC electrical devices, and a microSD card slot for data logging.

The entire board operates from a single 220VAC power input, featuring a high-power switching power supply, surge and transient voltage protection, and fuse protection. The integrated supply supports laboratory and field applications without an additional external power module.

overview.title: Key Design Highlight
overview.text: The I2C interface is accessible through a stacked USB-A connector, allowing users to connect I2C sensors using a standard USB cable without requiring specialized connectors. The I2C supply voltage can be selected between 3.3V and 5V using a jumper, enabling direct connection to 3.3V sensors (SHT31, BME280, SEN66, etc.) and compatible 5V sensors without an external level-shifting module. This connector carries I2C signals; it is not a standard USB data port.

featureCards.title: Wi-Fi & IoT-Cloud
featureCards.text: Dual-core ESP32 with 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth for sending sensor data to an IoT cloud platform.

featureCards.title: Local LoRa network
featureCards.text: Long-range LoRa communication. Reported lab-area testing: 1–1.5 km in an urban environment with trees and buildings; theoretical range: 10–15 km, depending on conditions.

featureCards.title: I2C sensors · 3.3V & 5V
featureCards.text: VCC / SCL / SDA / GND on a stacked USB-A connector. Select the 3.3V or 5V supply with a jumper for compatible sensors.

featureCards.title: UART sensor interface
featureCards.text: Dedicated 5V / Rx / Tx / GND connector for serial sensors and UART communication.

featureCards.title: Battery-backed RTC
featureCards.text: DS3231M real-time clock with a CR1220 backup battery to retain time when main power is lost.

featureCards.title: 2 ON/OFF relay channels
featureCards.text: Omron G5NB-1A relays with optocoupler isolation for controlling AC/DC electrical devices.

featureCards.title: microSD data logging
featureCards.text: On-board microSD slot for logging and storing data, including while the network connection is unavailable.

featureCards.title: 220VAC power input
featureCards.text: Integrated switching supply with surge and transient suppression and fuse protection.

name: Industrial Pump Controller & Data Logger
summary: STM32F407-based controller for industrial pump monitoring, VFD control and data logging.

RTC, EEPROM, SD card, relays and buzzer
2× CAN Bus, RS485, 2× RS232, Ethernet and SIM7600/GNSS

name: ESP32 PLC
summary: ESP32-S3 based PLC for industrial automation and IoT, with digital I/O, 4–20 mA analog interfaces and Modbus RS485.
description: This project presents a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) built on the ESP32-S3 microcontroller. The system is designed for industrial automation and IoT applications, combining powerful processing capabilities with versatile connectivity options.
disclaimer: Personal project by Hoàng Duy. Specifications describe the design; manufacturing and qualification results are not published.

overview.text: This project presents a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) built on the ESP32-S3 microcontroller. The system is designed for industrial automation and IoT applications, combining powerful processing capabilities with versatile connectivity options.

overview.title: Applications
overview.text: Industrial process control, data acquisition systems, smart agriculture, environmental monitoring, and custom automation projects.

featureCards.title: Digital I/O
featureCards.text: Supports multiple digital inputs and outputs for controlling relays, sensors, and actuators.

featureCards.title: Analog 4–20 mA Interface
featureCards.text: Compatible with standard industrial sensors and transmitters.

featureCards.title: Modbus RS485 Communication
featureCards.text: Enables reliable data exchange with industrial devices and other PLCs.

featureCards.title: SD Card Storage
featureCards.text: Provides local data logging and system configuration storage.

featureCards.title: RTC (Real-Time Clock)
featureCards.text: Maintains accurate timing for scheduling and event recording, even during power loss.

featureCards.title: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
featureCards.text: Built-in wireless connectivity for IoT integration and remote monitoring.

name: 6 Fan Controller
summary: STM32F070-based intelligent PC fan controller with six PWM channels, four adjustable-voltage channels and USB control.
description: An intelligent controller for up to six PC fans, based on the STM32F070 microcontroller. All six fans support PWM control, while four channels also provide supply-voltage adjustment for three-wire or two-wire fans.
disclaimer: Personal project by Hoàng Duy. Specifications describe the design; manufacturing and qualification results are not published.

overview.text: An intelligent controller for up to six PC fans, based on the STM32F070 microcontroller. All six fans support PWM control, while four channels also provide supply-voltage adjustment for three-wire or two-wire fans.

The system combines configurable DC-DC power stages, temperature monitoring, fan speed measurement, a 240×240 IPS display and USB connectivity. Control software initially targets Windows, with the exchange protocol and other sources planned for release.

featureCards.title: 6 PWM-controlled fans
featureCards.text: All six fans are controlled by PWM.

featureCards.title: 4 adjustable-voltage channels
featureCards.text: Four channels support supply-voltage adjustment for three-wire or two-wire fans.

featureCards.title: 128 linear voltage steps
featureCards.text: 128 steps of smooth, linear voltage adjustment.

featureCards.title: P-channel MOSFET power stages
featureCards.text: P-channel MOSFETs in the DC-DC converters allow almost lossless power transmission to the fans at 100% duty cycle.

featureCards.title: Full DC-DC shutdown
featureCards.text: Each DC-DC converter can be fully shut down.

featureCards.title: Up to 4A per DC-DC output
featureCards.text: DC-DC output currents up to 4A, with more than 15W per channel.

featureCards.title: Continued operation on MCU failure
featureCards.text: Designed for continued operation even when the microcontrollers fail.

featureCards.title: Voltage monitoring
featureCards.text: Sensors monitor both the DC-DC supply voltage and output voltage.

featureCards.title: Up to 16 DS18B20 sensors
featureCards.text: Two buses for digital temperature sensors, supporting up to 16 DS18B20 sensors.

featureCards.title: On-board temperature sensing
featureCards.text: Temperature sensors are built into the digital potentiometers and microcontroller.

featureCards.title: PC temperature monitoring
featureCards.text: Control software tracks the PC’s built-in motherboard, CPU, GPU and HDD temperature sensors.

featureCards.title: Indicators & alarm buzzer
featureCards.text: Power and error indicators plus an alarm buzzer.

featureCards.title: 240×240 IPS display
featureCards.text: An IPS display with 240×240 resolution provides a local interface.

featureCards.title: Accurate fan speed measurement
featureCards.text: A 32.768kHz crystal supports accurate fan speed measurement.

featureCards.title: USB connection
featureCards.text: USB connectivity between the fan controller and PC.

featureCards.title: Windows control software
featureCards.text: Control software initially targets Windows. The exchange protocol and other sources are planned for release.

featureCards.title: Flexible power options
featureCards.text: Molex (12V + 5V), 12V power + USB, Molex + 12V power, or a single 5–18V power supply.

featureCards.title: Automatic fan detection
featureCards.text: Automatic configuration and detection of connected fans.

featureCards.title: USB firmware updates
featureCards.text: Firmware can be updated via USB.

featureCards.title: 2.5-inch HDD mounting
featureCards.text: Mounting holes are compatible with a 2.5-inch HDD holder.
